name: prototype-canvas
title_zh: 本地画布上摆 HTML 稿，截图批注回传改稿闭环
tagline_zh: 不用切窗口、不用手动截图同步。启动即见 HTML 画板，拖拽摆放、框选批注，改完截图回传，布局重叠一眼揪出。
tagline_en: Stop juggling windows. Launch a tldraw canvas wired to your HTML boards, arrange, annotate, screenshot.
desc_en: Start and operate the local tldraw design canvas that shows HTML artboards. Launch the dev server against a project's board folders, add or switch boards, drive shapes through the bounded window.snapCanvas bridge, and act on annotated screenshots of the canvas. Use when asked to open/launch the canvas, put a mockup on the canvas, annotate or draw on it, fix overlapping frames after a layout.json e
why_zh: 它把设计画布变成可编程的桥：通过 window.snapCanvas 驱动形状，截图带坐标回注。
why_en: It turns the canvas into a programmable bridge: shapes driven via window.snapCanvas, annotated screenshots carry coordinates.
limit_zh: 只认本地项目里的 board 文件夹和 layout.json；不启动 dev server 就无画布可开。
limit_en: Only works with local board folders & layout.json; no dev server, no canvas. Screenshot feedback covers in-canvas shapes only—page elements outside.
title_en: Local tldraw canvas for HTML mockups, screenshot-annotate.
